en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding the slave men and the slave women when one of them commited adultery, that he would be whipped eighty lashes whether he was a Muslim, or an Infidel, or a Christian, and would neither be stoned nor exiled’.
